rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: A landlord ending a tenancy or not renewing a lease must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the notice to quit, and submit a copy of the notice and tenant contact information to the City. A violation does not halt the eviction.
rules.key_value: Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources delivered with every notice to quit/non-renewal; copy filed with City
rules.quoted_span:
The Notice of
Tenants’ Rights and Resources must be delivered at the same time as the Notice to
Quit
rules.effective_date_note: Tenant FAQ (D014) states HSNA becomes effective November 6, 2020; ordinance passed October 2020.
rules.exemptions: Residences in a hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility; non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facilities.
rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent: $300 per day (enforced by Inspectional Services Department).

unverifiable_exemptions: residence in hospital, skilled nursing or health facility
non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facility

rules.review_note: Notice-only ordinance; does not restrict grounds for eviction.

rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
rules.requirement: Housing providers with DND funding/land or BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy income-restricted units may not use a blanket ban on applicants with arrests or convictions and must review case by case. They may not consider non-conviction arrests, convictions with judicial relief, juvenile records, or convictions over 5 years old (with exceptions), and may not use credit scores to approve or deny applications.
rules.key_value: No blanket criminal-history bans; no arrests without conviction, juvenile records, convictions >5 years old; no credit scores
rules.citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (DND, Feb. 2017)
citation_aliases: Boston Department of Neighborhood Development Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
rules.quoted_span:
will not impose a blanket policy that denies 
housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions. Housing providers will consider applicants on 
a case-by-case basis
rules.effective_date_note: Only the February 2017 policy date is given.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies only to housing providers receiving DND funding or land, or with income-restricted units under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply where a conviction directly relates to the housing or poses unreasonable risk of substantial harm to others, or to current criminal behavior.
rules.interaction: Conflicting federal or state criminal-history requirements preempt this policy.

requires_unknown_facts: property receives DND funding or land, or has income-restricted units under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy

rules.review_note: Funding-conditioned policy under which providers agree to its terms, not a general ordinance.

no_rule_findings.finding: State law bars municipalities from enacting or enforcing rent control, so Boston has no local rent cap. Home-rule petition H.3744 to allow rent stabilization was sent to a study order and not enacted.
no_rule_findings.quoted_span: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind

no_rule_findings.finding: Home-rule petition H.3744, which also sought tenant eviction protections for Boston, was sent to a study order (H5035) and not enacted, so there is no local just-cause eviction rule (only the HSNA notice requirement).
no_rule_findings.quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections

parsed.notes: Boston: HSNA merged (c15, c16). Fair Chance policy kept as funding-conditioned. The Boston documents show no city security deposit, application fee, or algorithmic rent-setting rule, so none were added. D012 lists rental assistance as protected in Boston fair housing, but it states no operative ordinance or citation, so no screening record was made from it.
